title: FlagEvaluationEvent
description: One event emitted per evaluated flag. Queued, batched, and POSTed to `/v1/sdk/events:batch`. Mirror of the protobuf `FlagEvaluationEvent` and the OpenAPI components/schemas/FlagEvaluationEvent — kept in sync intentionally.

flag_id.description: UUID of the flag record. SDK reads from loaded FeatureFlag definition; backend uses directly as FK to feature_flags.id. Empty string for outcome = flag_not_found.

variant_key.description: Variant key returned. For outcome = flag_not_found, this is the default-for-type value stringified.

matched_rule_id.description: UUID of the matched rule, or empty string for non-matched outcomes. Empty (not null) to keep on-wire shape stable for strict-null languages.

reasoning_included.description: Whether the caller invoked the reasoning-enabled entry point. NOT whether reasoning is embedded in this event (it never is).

context_parameters.description: Context parameters minus those listed in private_parameters. Omit or null if all parameters were marked private.

environment_id.description: Populated by the gateway from the resolved SDK key. SDKs MUST leave empty on outbound payloads.
